description: This file defines classes and structures related to User Equipment (UE) context management within a Distributed Unit (DU) in a 5G RAN. It includes the 'du_ue_context' struct, 'du_ue_controller' interface, and 'du_ue' class, along with associated enums and includes for resource management and signaling.

classes.name: du_ue_context
classes.description: Holds the context information of a UE in the DU, including identifiers and cell info.

classes.name: du_ue_controller
classes.description: Interface for controlling and interacting with a DU UE's state and events.

classes.name: du_ue
classes.description: Represents a DU UE, combining context, control, bearers, resources, and mobility management.

methods.name: disable_rlf_detection
methods.description: Disables RLF detection for the UE, typically during removal or handover.

methods.name: handle_activity_stop_request
methods.description: Stops traffic for the UE's radio bearers, optionally including SRBs.

methods.name: handle_drb_stop_request
methods.description: Stops traffic for specific DRBs during reconfiguration.

methods.name: schedule_async_task
methods.description: Schedules an asynchronous task for the UE.

methods.name: handle_rlf_detection
methods.description: Handles detection of Radio Link Failure (RLF) caused by MAC or RLC issues.

methods.name: handle_crnti_ce_detection
methods.description: Handles detection of C-RNTI MAC Control Element for the UE.

methods.name: get_mac_rlf_notifier
methods.description: Provides access to the MAC RLF notifier.

methods.name: get_rlc_rlf_notifier
methods.description: Provides access to the RLC RLF notifier.
